name: p4-native
description: The host layer of ezexe/p4: at a session's start it works out what this host is and can do, the desktop app or a terminal, interactive or scripted, the Claude Code version and the tools that answer here, and keeps that map in the project's .claude/p4 store, where the session and the other p4 plugins read it, and when the Claude Code version changes it probes each condition that blocked a decision and tells the session once what changed, it names each command and tool of a new build that no p4 plugin has weighed, it hands one line when a session does by hand what a tool of this host does, and two native features wait behind options that are off by default.

push.title: Push when a turn ends
push.description: Calls Claude Code's PushNotification tool when a turn ends in a session ezexe is at, so ezexe hears that the session waits or is done. Off in a scripted run and in a session another session started.

status.title: Status line with the host
status.description: Pins one line under the prompt that names the host, whether the session is interactive or scripted, and the Claude Code version.

hints.title: One line at a miss
hints.description: Hands a session one line of context when it does by hand what a tool of this host does, once for each situation in a session. It refuses no call.
